title: Birmingham Frag Fest
wikitext:
== Introduction ==
Hosted the UK's first big lan duel tournament.

Sujoy Defeated Nightwing 12-11 on DM6 in the quarterfinals.

Cenobite beat Sujoy in one of the semifinals. 

In the end there were three players left, Jibsta, Danold and Cenobite. 

The final was a three way FFA on DM4.

== Results ==
'''1 on 1:'''
* 1st - [[Jibsta]]
* 2nd - [[Cenobite]]
* 3rd - [[Danold]]
* 4th (tied) - [[Sujoy]]

'''2 on 2:'''
* 1st - [[Sujoy]] and [[Nightwing]]
* 2nd - [[Jibsta]] and [[Danold]]
